rawContent: many organizations have shared powerful statements in the past weeks supporting #BlackLivesMatter and condemning anti-Black violence and brutality. i shared some thoughts with @stavziv about what to do if your organization is *not* part of that number.

“I am devastated that members of my community, as a Black person, literally had to die in order for people to listen,” said Carter. “but I’m going to take every opportunity I have to use this moment to make sure that people do not forget.” <-- current #mood. #BlackLivesMatter
